findings.issue: Hophal imperfect 3ms (be put to death) is rendered as active morirá, changing stem force.
Common noun name is capitalized as Nombre, a title-like capitalization not in the token.
Preposition ב with a 3ms suffix is smoothed to the direct-object clitic lo.
peregrino may narrow the sojourner/alien noun toward a pilgrim.

notes: The qal infinitive absolutes, Jehová, and the asyndetic como…como pair match the tokens.
